content.short: Sound.xyz is a decentralized music platform enabling artists to monetize work through NFTs and connect.
content.description: Sound.xyz is a revolutionary Web3 music platform designed to transform the music industry by enabling artists to capture the true value of their work. Through the issuance of high-quality music NFTs, the protocol allows musicians to connect directly with their most dedicated fans, bypassing traditional intermediaries. Built on the Ethereum ecosystem, Sound.xyz offers an immersive listening experience, verifiable ownership, and transparent royalty distribution mechanisms.
